items.title: Samsung Hosts #PlayGalaxy Cup World Final at Gamescom 2026
items.what_happened: Samsung Electronics today announced that it hosted the #PlayGalaxy Cup World Final from Aug. 27-28, and that the final was held at the company’s booth as part of its larger exhibition at Gamescom 2026, held at Koelnmesse in Cologne, Germany, from Aug. 26-30.
